prompt: Desktop web app for preparing a WhatsApp service message. A concise header, title and short explanation lead to a two-column work area. The left panel is a complete form with service, customer, username/email, optional password, profile, PIN and description, warranty text, and expiration date. The right panel shows a full, realistic example message, then copy and WhatsApp share actions. Use the approved clean category-standard composition, white panels, pale gray page background, Inter typography, restrained blue primary action, familiar accessible controls, and responsive proportions. This is a working product screen, not a marketing page. Keep all copy readable and keep form and preview clearly separated.
